messages.raw: §fDo Golden Carrots taste different than normal ones? I've actually never tried one before so I am pretty curious how they taste.
messages.text: Do Golden Carrots taste different than normal ones? I've actually never tried one before so I am pretty curious how they taste.
messages.zh: 金胡萝卜吃起来和普通胡萝卜不一样吗?我其实一次都没吃过,还挺好奇是什么味道的。

messages.raw: §fLet's taste...THIS IS DISGUSTING!!! Why would anyone waste such precious gold on this? Just like any other fancy food, expensive and gross...
messages.text: Let's taste...THIS IS DISGUSTING!!! Why would anyone waste such precious gold on this? Just like any other fancy food, expensive and gross...
messages.zh: 来尝一口……这也太难吃了!!! 谁会把这么珍贵的金子浪费在这种东西上?跟别的什么高档菜一样,又贵又难吃……

messages.text: They would've probably tasted bad anyways...
